about_the_game:
Heed the call to arms and defend the light! In this massive update, you will find more danger and rewards as you fight to stop the Chaos Elves from bringing about the end of the world. Prepare yourselves and take the plunge with a loaded Legendary Veiled Corruption Package and receive the following:

Mount: Veiled Amethyst Tekanin

Pet: Guardian Beltenus

Familiar Skin: Cinder Tekanin

Designer Bag (24 Slot)

Ellun (100 Pack)

Special Talisman Package (30-Day)
  • Special Taming Talisman (30-Day)
  • Special Tempering Talisman(30-Day)

Veiled Malachite Diadem

Gilded Finery Outfit

Veiled Borealis Wings

Orchid Fennec Fox (30-Day)

Limit 1 Legendary Veiled Corruption Package per account. Packages are not transferable.
